note: Bystanders as a foot chase passes through (traversal beats, crowd_push, car_hood, vault). Plays near the beat's marker.

lines.text: Hey! My cart! You pay for that mustard!
That's a pretzel cart, not a racetrack!
Off my hood! I just had it waxed! In Jersey!
That's a dent! That's a dent you're making!
Watch it, pal! There's people walking here!
Hey! Hey! Somebody stop him! Or her! Somebody!
Go get him, Clyde. I'll hold your coat.
Five bucks says he makes the fence.
Some of us work in the morning! Run quieter!
Ethel! Ethel! There's a guy on the fire escape again!
That's my laundry! You're running through my laundry!
My birds! You scared my birds!
Hey, this is a private tar beach! Members only!
Mind the gap, Romeo. Last guy didn't.
Hey, you gotta pay like everybody else!
Thirty-five cents. You're running from thirty-five cents?
That fence bites! Watch your pants!
My papers! The evening edition's all over Eighth!
